text:
Renee Cho: Quick note 1: candidate Mateo Lopez requested ASL interpretation for onsite interviews and will arrive by train; needs travel reimbursement for ticket. Can we confirm interpreter booking + travel pre-approval?

Samir Patel: We have a vendor (SignConnect) we use. I can book an interpreter for the morning slot (09:30-12:00). Need candidate's preferred name on badge and ETA.

Jules Harper: Panel availability: I can do 09:30-10:15 PT, but interviewer in UK (Nina) is only available 5pm BST (9am PT). That lines up okay.

Renee Cho: Great. Plan: condensed morning loop 09:30-11:00 PT, interpreter from 09:25-11:05 to cover breaks. I'll pre-approve travel up to $120 for train/taxi. Recruiter please collect receipt and route to Expensify with code "CARE-INTERVIEW".

Recruiter Bot: Policy reminder: Accessibility & travel reimbursements available when pre-approved. Submit receipts to Expensify with code "ACCESS-TRAVEL". Approval must be logged before payment.

Renee Cho: @Samir please confirm SignConnect booking and invoice flow. @Jules confirm panel: Jules, Nina, and Mark.

Samir Patel: Booked with SignConnect. Interpreter: Ana R. Booking ID: SC-5543. I'll email candidate and vendor 24h before. Invoice will go to people-ops billing.

Candidate - Mateo: Thanks everyone. I'll send train ticket once booked and confirm arrival time. Appreciate the interpreter support.

Jules Harper: All set here. Can we reserve Quiet Room C and a guest badge?

Renee Cho: Reserving Quiet Room C and requesting guest badge. Adding prep note to the invite that interviewers should use the on-call captions on the shared doc if needed. Calendar invite will include interpreter name and booking ID.

Recruiter Bot: Candidate receipt submitted to recruiter inbox. Remember to tag expense with ACCESS-TRAVEL and attach pre-approval message.

Renee Cho: Thanks team . I'll follow up once interpreter confirms arrival window.
